# Bootstrap Icons 1.13.2

Unmodified font assets from the official `bootstrap-icons@1.13.2` npm package.
Source: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.13.2
Usage: https://icons.getbootstrap.com/usage/

MIT license: see LICENSE. CSS and both font formats are hosted locally so the
viewer does not need a third-party icon CDN. Update the CSS and fonts together.
